input: hey, planing a winter day trip from seoul for a saturday in mid-january. family of 4, 2 adults and our kids (7 and 10), back home same evening so max ~2.5 hrs drive. we want the big famous gangwon winter festival everyone goes to, the classic korean winter thing out on the snow or ice. the kids should get their lunch with their own two hands and have it grilled right there on site. something exciting theyll brag about at school. needs to be one package booked ahead (entry + activities + lunch), budget ₩150,000-250,000. can you book it for us?

experiences.name: Gangchon Snow Resort – Family Snow Day
experiences.description: Family day package with sledding and a two-hour beginner ski lesson for the kids, equipment rental included. About 1.5 h from Seoul by ITX-Cheongchun train. Lunch vouchers for four at the lodge cafeteria, serving bibimbap, udon and kimchi fried rice.

experiences.name: Hwacheon Sancheoneo Ice Festival – Family Ice Fishing & Grill Package
experiences.description: Family package for four at Korea's best-known winter festival on the frozen Hwacheon stream. Farmed masu salmon (sancheoneo) are released under the ice and into an outdoor pool of near-freezing water; visitors hook them through ice holes or grab them by hand, carry them out and take them to the grilling centre, where they are salt-grilled for lunch. About 2–2.5 h from Seoul by car or festival shuttle bus; rods and bait sold; heated rest tents, ice sledding and bobsled; part of admission returned as local gift vouchers.

experiences.name: Cheorwon Hantan River Ice Village – Family Ice & Rice-Cake Day
experiences.description: Family package for four, Saturdays in January, on the frozen Hantan River about 2 h from Seoul via National Route 43. The ice is used only for sledding, skating and ice slides; in the winter food zone, kids pound injeolmi with wooden mallets and roast sweet potatoes and chestnuts over charcoal for their lunch. The festival runs no fishing, live-animal handling or animal-contact activities. Sleds, skates and parking included; heated tents; lunch set of injeolmi, roasted sweet potatoes and chestnuts, vegetable japchae and hot sikhye.

experiences.name: Little Chef Studio – Family Gimbap & Hotteok Class
experiences.description: A 90-minute family cooking class on Saturday at 11:00 in a bright Mapo studio. Kids roll vegetable gimbap and fill and griddle hotteok alongside their parents, with all ingredients and aprons provided. Leftovers are packed to take home.

experiences.name: Seorak Valley Snow Trout Festival – Family Ice Fishing & Grill Pass
experiences.description: Family pass for four, Saturdays in January, at Inje's winter festival on a frozen mountain reservoir. Farmed rainbow trout are released into the reservoir and an outdoor cold-water pool; visitors hook them through ice holes or grab them by hand and take them to the riverside grill tent, where they are grilled for lunch. About 2.5 h from Seoul via the Seoul–Yangyang Expressway; rental rods and ice scoops, a snow sledding hill and spinning ice sleds, heated tents with tables, and parking included.

experiences.name: Yangpyeong Snowberry Farm – Winter Pick & Grill Family Day
experiences.description: Family package for four, Saturdays in January, about 1 h from Seoul via the Seoul–Yangyang Expressway or the Gyeongui–Jungang Line. Kids pick strawberries from heated greenhouse raised beds at peak January harvest, sled the farm's snow hill, then grill rice-cake skewers, roast sweet potatoes over charcoal and dip strawberries for tanghulu. The food activities are fruit picking and grilling only; the farm runs no fishing, live-animal handling or animal-contact activities. Lunch set: rice-cake skewers, sweet potatoes, tteokguk and strawberry tanghulu; sleds included.

experiences.name: Seoul Plaza Skate & Bingsu Afternoon
experiences.description: A one-hour Saturday skating slot for four at the outdoor Seoul Plaza rink, skate and helmet rental included, followed by a table reserved for 14:00 at a winter dessert café in Jung-gu, a 5-minute walk away. Patbingsu, hotteok and hot chocolate for the family.
